$comment: Decision-relevant provider facts for SBLA-003. Each fact was re-read from the cited official provider documentation on the access date. Fields labelled inference, capacityInference, proposedDirection, projectDecision, or operationalFallback are project conclusions, not provider promises.

providers.role: proposed Release 1 static host and asset host; owner approval pending

quotas.functionsNote: Shared Workers Free and Pages Functions quota; resets at midnight UTC. Release 1 does not use Functions.

costControl.providerFact: The cited Pages docs describe Free-plan limits and free, unlimited static asset requests; they do not describe automatic conversion of a Free Pages project to a paid plan.
costControl.proposedDirection: Use only static Pages features. Do not add Pages Functions or a paid plan. Owner approval remains pending.

alerting.providerFact: Cloudflare documents usage-based billing notifications for Professional plans or higher and Pay-as-you-go accounts. The reviewed docs do not document a Free Pages build-count alert.
alerting.inference: Configurable 70% and 85% Pages-build alerts are not supported by the documented Free-plan controls.
alerting.operationalFallback: Review the Pages build count weekly. At 350 builds in a month, batch non-urgent changes; at 425, permit only correction or release-blocking builds until reset.

providers.role: considered but not selected for Release 1 asset delivery
providers.plan: Standard storage with monthly free tier and metered overage

quotas.freeTierCaveat: The free tier applies only to Standard storage, not Infrequent Access.

costControl.providerFact: R2 usage above the free tier is billed, and Cloudflare threshold billing automatically charges a payment method when accumulated usage charges reach the account threshold.
costControl.projectDecision: Do not activate R2 for Release 1 because the product plan forbids a service that can incur usage charges. Assets must remain within Pages limits or degrade to the 2D fallback.

alerting.providerFact: Cloudflare budget alerts use dollar thresholds, are informational, and do not pause or cap usage.
alerting.projectDecision: No R2 alerts are configured because R2 is not activated. Alerts cannot substitute for the required hard no-charge boundary.

quotas.buildsPerHour: 10 soft limit; not applicable when publishing with a custom GitHub Actions workflow
quotas.usageRestriction: not intended for or allowed as free hosting for an online business, e-commerce site, or commercial SaaS

alerting.providerFact: The Pages limits page says GitHub Support may email when quotas are exceeded; it does not document configurable 70% or 85% Pages bandwidth alerts.
alerting.inference: The requested thresholds are not supported for GitHub Pages in the reviewed documentation.

providers.role: portability alternative considered and not selected

quotas.derivedBandwidthCeiling: 15 GB/month if all 300 credits were used for bandwidth; requests and production deploys reduce it
quotas.hardLimit: The Free plan has hard monthly limits that cannot be exceeded or incur costs.

alerting.providerFact: Free-plan usage notices are fixed at 50%, 75%, and 100%.
alerting.inference: Exact 70% and 85% thresholds are not configurable in the documented Free plan.

providers.role: optional post-launch aggregate pageview analytics candidate; launch baseline is no analytics and owner approval remains pending

costPrivacyAndPersonalData.fact: Cloudflare describes Web Analytics as free and privacy-first and says it does not collect or use visitors' personal data.

clientSideStateAndFingerprinting.fact: Cloudflare says Web Analytics does not use cookies, localStorage, or other client-side state and does not fingerprint individuals by IP address, User Agent, or other data for analytics.

reportTiming.fact: For traditional pages, the beacon reports at the load event and when the user leaves; Core Web Vitals are reported at the first hidden visibility state after load.
reportTiming.capacityInference: Model two reports per completed traditional pageview and take no credit for report loss.

subresourceIntegrity.fact: Cloudflare says automatic injection includes an integrity attribute, while the manually embedded beacon cannot safely use an integrity attribute because the beacon is not version-pinned. Pages can automatically add the snippet on the next deployment when Web Analytics is enabled for the project.
subresourceIntegrity.projectDecision: Launch without analytics. Permit optional activation only through automatic injection after the emitted production HTML is verified to contain an integrity attribute; never use the manual embed.

samplingRetentionQueriesAndEvents.fact: Every received beacon is recorded without ingestion sampling; unsampled data is retained for 7 days then aggregated to around 10%; query sampling ranges from 0.0001% to 100%; query strings are not logged; custom events are not supported.

documentedLimits.fact: The Limits page lists 10 non-proxied sites, no proxied-site limit, 1,000 websites viewed in parallel, and plan-specific rule limits including zero rules on Free.
documentedLimits.inference: The official Limits page documents no report-ingestion quota. This is not a claim of unlimited ingestion.

coreWebVitalsPrivacy.fact: The Core Web Vitals page repeats that the beacon uses no cookies or localStorage and does not fingerprint individuals.

quotas.documentedIngestionQuota: not stated on the official Web Analytics Limits page; this sourced absence is not unlimited capacity

capacityModel.activationGate: Automatic injection only, with the emitted production script tag verified to contain an integrity attribute; otherwise analytics remains disabled.

measuredTransfer.measurement: curl response from static.cloudflareinsights.com with identity and gzip Accept-Encoding on 2026-09-03; cache-control max-age=86400; etag W/"2026.9.1"
measuredTransfer.priorMeasurement: 28,467 raw bytes and 9,509 gzip bytes on 2026-09-01; the change demonstrates that the unversioned script is volatile and must not be presented with false precision.
measuredTransfer.reportPayloadBytes: not measured because no production analytics site/token exists
